CORPUS.refund-primary: 年付订阅的退款资格以公示的退款窗口期为准。Annual refunds follow the published eligibility window.
CORPUS.refund-window: 退款窗口在订阅续期前 7 天开启，逾期不可退。The refund window opens 7 days before renewal and closes at renewal.
CORPUS.refund-near-monthly: 月付订阅可随时取消，不产生退款。Monthly plans can be cancelled anytime and are never refunded.
CORPUS.refund-near-coupon: 优惠券一经使用不予退还。Used coupons are non-refundable.
CORPUS.refund-near-invoice: 发票金额与实付一致。Invoice amounts match the charged total.
CORPUS.password-primary: 重置链接会发送到已验证的账户渠道。A reset link is sent to the verified account channel.
CORPUS.password-window: 已验证渠道包括注册邮箱与绑定手机号。Verified channels are the registered email and the bound phone number.
CORPUS.password-near-2fa: 双因素验证码在登录时输入，与密码重置无关。Two-factor codes are for login, not password reset.
CORPUS.password-near-change: 修改密码需先登录并进入安全设置。Changing a password requires signing in first.
CORPUS.password-near-session: 会话令牌过期后需重新登录。Session tokens expire and require re-login.
CORPUS.invoice-primary: 最新发票可在账单历史中查看。The latest invoice is available in billing history.
CORPUS.invoice-window: 账单历史保留最近 24 个月的发票记录。Billing history keeps the last 24 months of invoices.
CORPUS.invoice-near-receipt: 支付即时回执显示在付款确认页。Immediate payment receipts appear on the confirmation page.
CORPUS.invoice-near-tax: 税额按注册地区规则自动计算。Tax is calculated by region.
CORPUS.invoice-near-refund: 退款不会生成新发票。Refunds do not create a new invoice.
CORPUS.approval-primary: 仅在存在当前且匹配的有效审批后，工具才会执行。A high-risk tool executes only after a current matching approval.
CORPUS.approval-window: 审批绑定具体工具与参数，过期即失效。Approvals are bound to a specific tool and expire.
CORPUS.approval-near-log: 审计日志记录每次工具调用结果。Audit logs record each tool call outcome.
CORPUS.approval-near-lowrisk: 低风险工具无需审批即可运行。Low-risk tools run without approval.
CORPUS.approval-near-scope: 工具权限范围在安装时确定。Tool scope is fixed at install.
CORPUS.compaction-primary: 压缩须保留目标、约束、决策以及检查点的连续性。Compaction retains goal, constraints, decisions, and checkpoint continuity.
CORPUS.compaction-window: 被压缩的原始轮次仍可回溯到检查点。Compacted turns stay traceable to a checkpoint.
CORPUS.compaction-near-summary: 摘要只是压缩的副产物，不保证决策连续。A summary is a byproduct and need not preserve decisions.
CORPUS.compaction-near-truncate: 直接截断会丢弃早期上下文，不属于压缩。Hard truncation drops early context; it is not compaction.
CORPUS.compaction-near-token: 令牌计数用于成本估算。Token counting is for cost estimates.
CORPUS.tenant-primary: 检索严格限定在当前已认证租户范围内。Retrieval is restricted to the authenticated tenant.
CORPUS.tenant-window: 跨租户命中会在授权层被过滤丢弃。Cross-tenant hits are filtered at the authorization layer.
CORPUS.tenant-near-cache: 缓存键含租户命名空间。Cache keys carry a tenant namespace.
CORPUS.tenant-near-share: 共享链接需显式授权才可访问。Shared links require explicit grant to access.
CORPUS.tenant-near-metric: 指标按租户维度聚合。Metrics are aggregated per tenant.
